plan.objective: Prioritize concurrent decode stability while admitting intermittent new prefills; no engine or service changes.
schedule: Refuse to begin unless the existing loopback service is loaded and reports zero requests in flight.
Run each selected concurrency level sequentially. Levels count resident workers; one injected request is additional admission pressure.
Require all resident streams to have produced nonempty reasoning/content/tool output and to remain active with output in the last second for the stable-ready interval before baseline.
Measure resident-only baseline, then inject the six nominal 10k/60k requests at fixed planned offsets, serializing injections if an earlier one is still pending.
Resident requests refill after natural completion, reusing their lane's synthetic prefix. Record refill/admission gaps rather than assuming constant active decode.
After the last injected request completes, measure recovery, stop refills, and allow bounded natural drain. Close only this client's sockets if a timeout occurs.
Never clear caches, read serving logs, send administrative requests, start/stop servers, or change configuration.
plan.cold_request_rule: Fresh synthetic early prefix for each injected request; confirm exact prompt_tokens and cached_tokens from API usage. A nonzero or missing cached count is not labeled verified zero-cache.
plan.admission_note: Eight resident streams plus one injected request intentionally exceed an eight-slot engine; resulting queue TTFT is measured, not treated as nine active GPU slots.

latency: TTFT to first nonempty reasoning/content/tool delta; first visible content, first reasoning and first tool delta are separate
Per-channel and combined inter-output-chunk gap p50/p95/p99/max; no per-token TBT
Terminal silence lower bound for failed/cancelled streams; active-stream counter with no new output in the last second
throughput: all-output UTF-8 bytes per second (reasoning/content/tool name+arguments); visible-content byte rate separately
usage-weighted per-chunk token estimates where final usage is available
byte/4 fallback explicitly marked heuristic for incomplete streams
completed-request API token count divided by whole scenario time; lower bound if usage is missing
metrics.fairness: Per-resident-lane all-output byte rate and Jain index in the same wall-time windows; includes reasoning/tool text, refills and zero-output intervals. This is a progress proxy, not equal work or token fairness.
metrics.recovery: First of the configured consecutive bins after injection completion reaching 90% of baseline aggregate resident all-output byte rate; descriptive progress metric.
metrics.occupancy: Client-side requests in flight and streams that have produced first content, sampled every 250 ms; neither equals confirmed GPU occupancy.

interpretation: SSE chunks can contain multiple tokens or partial textual tokens. There is no per-token timestamp; inter-chunk gaps must not be called token TBT.
Per-chunk token allocation from final usage and visible bytes is a throughput estimate, never measured token boundary timing.
TTFT includes client processing, queue/admission, prefix handling, prefill and first output. The first-content bound is only a prefill/admission proxy.
The default six injections give only three observations per prompt size and level; p95/p99 are descriptive order statistics, not stable tail-SLO estimates.
Prioritize lower resident tail gaps/stalls and injected TTFT, fair progress and recovery. Throughput alone does not pass a candidate.
Compare matched configurations and actual prompt/cache counts; no automatic performance pass threshold or deployment is performed.
plan.execution_guard: Dry-run by default; short profile by default. Sending HTTP requires --execute --exclusive-benchmark --port --config --out, loopback only.
profile_notes: short is an admission/stability qualification with nominal 10k resident contexts, not a 100k result; --resident-context-tokens 100000 can explicitly override it.
Run greedy and sampled as separate invocations/directories with otherwise matched plan/configuration. Do not pool their metrics.
Prioritize short level4, then level2; level8+intruder is a capacity/queue case, not a four-resident preemption case.
No tools are executed. Parsing recognizes content, reasoning and tool-call deltas, with separate first-arrival and channel-gap clocks.

privacy: Only synthetic request/response hashes, byte counts and timings; no text, credentials, logs or tools executed.
